question: During the 6th edition of the Khelo India Winter Games 2026 held in Leh in January 2026, which team retained the gold medal in the men’s ice hockey event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Army**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Army** team demonstrated exceptional skill and strategy to retain the **gold medal** in the **men’s ice hockey** event during the **6th edition** of the **Khelo India Winter Games**.
 
• The tournament was held in **January 2026** in the high-altitude terrain of **Leh**, located in the Union Territory of **Ladakh**, which provides the necessary freezing conditions for natural ice rinks.
 
• In the final match, the **Indian Army** (often comprising personnel from the **Ladakh Scouts** regiment) defeated the **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)** to claim the top spot on the podium.
 
• The victory highlights the **Indian Army's** continued dominance in winter sports, a result of their specialized training and deployment in **Himalayan** regions like **Siachen** and **eastern Ladakh**.
 
• The **Khelo India Winter Games** is a flagship initiative organized by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** to encourage a culture of sports and identify grassroots talent in disciplines like **ice hockey**, **alpine skiing**, and **snowboarding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)**:
 
 
• A **Central Armed Police Force (CAPF)** primarily responsible for guarding the **India-China border**.
 
• The **ITBP** is a formidable competitor in winter sports due to their **mountaineering** expertise and finished the tournament as the **silver medalists**.
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh and Chandigarh**:
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** is a key participating state that frequently hosts winter sports trials in **Manali** and **Lahaul-Spiti**.
 
• **Chandigarh**, as a Union Territory, participates in the games to promote **ice skating** and **ice hockey** among urban athletes.
 
 
 
• **Ice Hockey Association of India (IHAI)**:
 
 
• The governing body for **ice hockey** in the country, which works in tandem with the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)** to conduct these national-level games.
